name: VNMap Core
source_of_truth: OpenStreetMap PBF under its applicable license
Vietnam administrative/geospatial datasets only when redistribution rights are documented

basemap.role: water, landuse, administrative boundaries, place labels

transport.role: roads, links, rail, ferry and transport infrastructure

poi.role: points of interest and address search/render features

attribution: VNMap Core · bootstrap data © OpenStreetMap contributors / OpenMapTiles via OpenFreeMap until Vietflex datasets are published
notes: Bootstrap mode deliberately uses an external open vector style so the menu entry works before self-hosted tiles are published.
Set status=ready and data_ready=true only after the four domain tiles, style, sprite/glyph assets and provenance are published.
Commercial or third-party providers such as TEDP/VNPT/Google/Mapbox belong in adapters, not in VNMap Core.
